main.description: Validate if a DID is a supporter of another identity with attestations from a specific signer.

signer.description: DID of the signer whose attestation must be valid.

subject.description: DID of the subject (creator) being supported.

supporter.description: DID of the supporter to validate.

profile.description: Hydrated profile of the supporter, if available.

valid.description: Whether the supporter relationship exists and the required attestation is valid.

errors.description: Invalid DID format or missing required parameters.
errors.name: InvalidRequest
